description: --shard=2/3 (T9.6): Jest sorts the files by the sha1 of their path relative to the root, then runs the 2-th contiguous slice of that order; the first length % count slices are one file longer, so 8 files split 3, 3, 2. Applied after the file filters and before the order. A black-box run whose PASS lines name the files of the shard.
